note: Hook structures, not templates to paste. Examples are fictional (persona Maya Rivera) and carry no figures; any number you add must come through meta.claims.

formulas.name: Anaphora
formulas.structure_en: Repeat one opening phrase three times, then land the point.
formulas.structure_ar: كرّر جملة افتتاحية ثلاث مرات ثم اذكر الخلاصة.
never_for: a topic with only one point
formulas.example_en: I stopped guessing. I stopped copying. I started measuring.

formulas.name: R.I.P. the old way
formulas.structure_en: R.I.P. {old habit}. Here is what replaced it.
formulas.structure_ar: وداعا لـ {عادة قديمة}. وهذا ما حلّ مكانها.
never_for: when the old way is the reader's employer
formulas.example_en: R.I.P. the monthly status report.

formulas.name: Year pivot
formulas.structure_en: In {year} I did X. In {year} I do Y. The gap is the lesson.
formulas.structure_ar: في {سنة} كنت أفعل س. اليوم أفعل ص. الفرق هو الدرس.
formulas.example_en: In 2019 I handed in reports. Now I hand in decisions.

formulas.name: Time anchor
formulas.structure_en: {When} I {did X}. Here is what happened next.
formulas.structure_ar: {متى} فعلت س. وهذا ما جرى بعد ذلك.
formulas.example_en: On Monday I deleted a dashboard nobody opened.

formulas.name: Curiosity gap
formulas.structure_en: State the result, hold back the method until line three.
formulas.structure_ar: اذكر النتيجة وأجّل الطريقة إلى السطر الثالث.
never_for: when the payoff is weak; the reader feels cheated
formulas.example_en: One chart fixed the weekly argument.

formulas.name: Contrarian
formulas.structure_en: Common belief X is wrong for {audience}. Here is the evidence.
formulas.structure_ar: الاعتقاد الشائع س خاطئ لـ {الجمهور}. وهذه الأدلة.
formulas.example_en: More data rarely settles the argument.

formulas.name: False binary
formulas.structure_en: Skip the A-or-B debate; the order you do them in matters more.
formulas.structure_ar: تجاوز جدال أ أو ب؛ ترتيب التنفيذ أهم.
never_for: when the two options really are exclusive
formulas.example_en: Skip the tool debate. The order of the questions matters more.

formulas.name: Emotional cold open
formulas.structure_en: Open on the moment, one sentence, no context.
formulas.structure_ar: ابدأ باللحظة نفسها في جملة واحدة بلا تمهيد.
formulas.example_en: The room went quiet when the chart loaded.

formulas.name: Named gratitude
formulas.structure_en: Thank a real person for one specific thing they did.
formulas.structure_ar: اشكر شخصا حقيقيا على شيء محدد فعله.
formulas.example_en: Thanks to a teammate who read my draft twice.

formulas.name: Numbered list
formulas.structure_en: {N} things about {topic}, one line each.
formulas.structure_ar: {عدد} أشياء عن {الموضوع} في سطر لكل منها.
never_for: lists padded to reach a round number
formulas.example_en: Five checks before I send a report.

formulas.name: Before and after
formulas.structure_en: Before: X. After: Y. The change: Z.
formulas.structure_ar: قبل: س. بعد: ص. ما تغيّر: ع.
formulas.example_en: Before: ten tabs of figures. After: one page.

formulas.name: Mistake confession
formulas.structure_en: I got X wrong. Here is what it cost and what I do now.
formulas.structure_ar: أخطأت في س. وهذه كلفته وما أفعله الآن.
formulas.example_en: I shipped a chart with the axis cut off.

formulas.name: Behind the scenes
formulas.structure_en: Show the unglamorous middle of a piece of work.
formulas.structure_ar: أظهر الجزء غير اللامع من منتصف العمل.
formulas.example_en: What a messy spreadsheet looks like before it becomes a chart.

formulas.name: Question with stakes
formulas.structure_en: Ask one concrete question and say why the answer matters.
formulas.structure_ar: اطرح سؤالا محددا واشرح لماذا تهمّ الإجابة.
formulas.example_en: Which report did your team stop reading, and why?

formulas.name: Myth and fact
formulas.structure_en: Myth: X. Fact: Y, with the source.
formulas.structure_ar: خرافة: س. حقيقة: ص، مع المصدر.
formulas.example_en: Myth: a dashboard is a decision. Fact: a dashboard is a question.

formulas.name: One-line lesson
formulas.structure_en: Lead with the lesson, then the short story that earned it.
formulas.structure_ar: ابدأ بالدرس ثم القصة القصيرة التي أنتجته.
never_for: lessons that do not follow from the story
formulas.example_en: Write the decision first, then the analysis.

formulas.name: Reframe a quote
formulas.structure_en: Quote a familiar line and change one word.
formulas.structure_ar: اقتبس عبارة مألوفة وغيّر كلمة واحدة.
formulas.example_en: Done is better than perfect; reviewed is better than done.

formulas.name: Mini case
formulas.structure_en: Problem, move, result in four short lines.
formulas.structure_ar: مشكلة، خطوة، نتيجة في أربعة أسطر قصيرة.
never_for: results not in the facts register
formulas.example_en: A clinic could not see its no-show pattern. I plotted it. They moved the reminder.

formulas.name: Checklist promise
formulas.structure_en: Promise a checklist in the hook and deliver it in full.
formulas.structure_ar: عِد بقائمة تحقق في الافتتاحية وسلّمها كاملة.
formulas.example_en: A checklist I run before I share any chart.

formulas.name: Availability note
formulas.structure_en: Say what you do, for whom, and when you have room.
formulas.structure_ar: اذكر ما تفعله ولمن ومتى يتوفر لديك وقت.
never_for: goal job_seeking (use job-seeking wording only when the goal allows it)
formulas.example_en: I help small non-profits read their own data. I have room for one project in spring.
